bio: A silkworm that spins a new outfit every morning and has eaten the old one by noon. It copies the pattern of any leaf it sees.
It hangs in its cocoon like a dress on a rail. Inside it is taking in the seams; tap the cocoon and a price tag rattles.
A moth whose wings carry this week's print. In two weeks they carry another. It flies to every light in the shopping street and never once to the cameras.
